frequent.en: The first is that big technology companies are still investing in nuclear energy despite these frequent cost overruns , which gives you some idea of just how desperate they are for power.
frequent.zh: 第一，尽管成本超支频发，大型科技公司仍在投资核能，这足以说明它们对电力有多么渴望。

freeze.en: Ready-made sauces and frozen foods became common.
freeze.zh: 现成酱汁和冷冻食品变得很常见。

freeze.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
freeze.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

fry.en: British cuisine, though, is associated with pubs and fish and chips and fried breakfasts.
fry.zh: 然而，英国菜却与酒吧、炸鱼薯条和炸早餐联系在一起。

fry.en: Fried fish has connections to Jewish communities who came to Britain from Spain and Portugal.
fry.zh: 炸鱼与从西班牙和葡萄牙来到英国的犹太社区有联系。
